channel.title: Wyatt's Notes — Computer Science
channel.description: Undergraduate computer science theory and algorithms notes.

item.title: Big-O Notation and Complexity Analysis
item.description: Time and space complexity, Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta, amortised analysis, and solving recurrences with the Master theorem.

item.title: Graph Algorithms
item.description: BFS, DFS, shortest path algorithms (Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford), minimum spanning trees (Prim, Kruskal), and topological sorting.

item.title: Propositional and Predicate Logic
item.description: Logical connectives, truth tables, normal forms, quantifiers, logical equivalence, and applications to computer science verification.

item.title: Hash Tables and Hashing
item.description: Hash functions, collision resolution (chaining, open addressing), load factors, and amortised O(1) operations with worked examples.

item.title: Binary Search Trees and Red-Black Trees
item.description: BST operations, balanced trees, red-black tree properties, rotations, and comparison with AVL trees and skip lists.

item.title: The OSI Model and Network Layers
item.description: Seven layers of the OSI model, encapsulation, protocol data units, and the TCP/IP stack with real-world protocol mappings.

item.title: Formal Languages and Automata
item.description: Regular expressions, finite automata, context-free grammars, pushdown automata, and the Chomsky hierarchy with examples.

item.title: Relational Databases and SQL
item.description: Relational model, normalisation (1NF-3NF), SQL queries, joins, indexing, and transaction isolation levels with practical examples.

item.title: Process and Thread Management
item.description: Process states, context switching, threads vs processes, scheduling algorithms, and synchronisation primitives like mutexes and semaphores.

item.title: Computability and the Halting Problem
item.description: Turing machines, decidable and recognisable languages, reductions, and the undecidability of the Halting Problem with proof outline.

item.title: Memory Management and Virtual Memory
item.description: Physical and virtual memory, paging, segmentation, page replacement algorithms, and TLB with worked calculations.

item.title: Dynamic Programming
item.description: Optimal substructure, memoisation, tabulation, and classic problems including knapsack, longest common subsequence, and matrix chain multiplication.

item.title: NP-Completeness and Reductions
item.description: Complexity classes P, NP, and NP-complete, polynomial-time reductions, and classic NP-complete problems like SAT and 3-COLOR.

item.title: Computer Science — Complete Guide
item.description: Undergraduate computer science notes covering algorithms, discrete mathematics, data structures, networks, theory, databases, operating systems, and computability.
